Volume multiple of the baseline (relative / session). volume_spike

Only bars that closed up / down (default any). volume_spike

Several weekdays (0 = Sunday) of a daily / weekly reminder. price_reminder

Only these of the script's alerts (its version's `alert_ids`); empty = all. script
Required release kinds for a macro alert
Optional economic dataset families
Optional public macro series identifiers
`once` = the alert becomes `triggered` after its first fire (default every_time)
Minimum seconds between fires (at most 366 days)

The alert becomes `triggered` after this many fires
The alert becomes `expired` then (ISO 8601 date-time with offset, e.g. 2026-12-01T14:30:00Z)

The alert is `scheduled` until then (ISO 8601 date-time with offset, e.g. 2026-12-01T14:30:00Z)
